title: Transit Diodes on a phone
description: Transit Diodes redeploys up to four ground forces at the start of a turn; the engine asks one option per source place x ground force type x controlled planet (here 13 planets, 7 places, 150+ options). It used to render as a planet selection that grouped moves by destination and showed them in a clipped row, so on a phone the wanted move could not be picked. It now has its own stepwise panel: what moves, where to, Confirm, with system tags, planet values and troops, 44 px targets and a list that scrolls inside the panel. Option ids are unchanged. Before shots were taken with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before on the base commit (e6c3cd1d); npm run screenshots -- CR regenerates the after shots. Synthetic fixtures through the mocked server, options generated exactly like the engine's transit_options.

shots.heading: Before, 390x844: the question
shots.caption: Transit Diodes was a planet selection: one chip per destination planet in a box that cuts off after three rows (Rarron, Sol's Jord and Finish redeployment below the fold), with no system, no source and nothing saying what moves.

shots.heading: Before, 390x844: after tapping Jord
shots.caption: Every source x unit for that destination becomes a button in one non-wrapping row, wider than the panel and clipped on both sides, labelled with raw ids ('Move infantry from tarmann to jord'). The prompt line overflows too. The wanted move cannot be reached.

shots.heading: Before, 390x844: after tapping Sol's Jord
shots.caption: Two different planets are both called Jord; the row of moves is still clipped.

notes.title: Engine
notes.text: No engine change: the client reads source_system, source, unit, destination_system and planet from each option's payload and only ever submits one of the offered ids. Nothing added to canonical() or the fingerprint.

notes.title: Asserted
notes.text: Panel inside the viewport, no horizontal scroll, the list scrolls, Confirm and Finish redeployment visible at every step, every force, destination and action button at least 44 px tall, the summary text, and the submitted option id.
